title: VK-only Write Single Register: other protocol sequence for heap-buffer layout analogue
purpose: Create a distinct mutation-friendly request using conservative register value and unit identifier.
expected_behavior: A conforming server should return a normal confirmation for function 06, or a well-formed Modbus exception if the register is unavailable; request parsing should remain bounded by the declared MBAP length.
constraints_preserved: Modbus/TCP MBAP header is seven bytes
MBAP length 0007 matches the unit byte and six-byte function payload
Function code 06 carries one register address and one 16-bit value
issue_safety_notes: The seed explores the issue-supported crafted-request surface without using any supplied historical PoC bytes. It is intended as a mutation base, not as a claim that this value reproduces issue 614.
